anomalies.description: A white SUV loses control on a curved road, swerves sharply right, and collides with the roadside guardrail or embankment, kicking up dust/debris.
A silver sedan on the right side of the road suddenly swerves left and collides with a red car ahead in the same lane, causing visible impact and dust/debris.

A large blue truck overtakes the dark van on the left while the dashcam vehicle is following the van; the truck appears to cut in sharply or collide with the van, causing the van to swerve right toward the roadside barrier and the dashcam vehicle to veer sharply left (evidenced by sudden camera tilt and frame obstruction at f14–f15).

A red car approaches rapidly from behind in the left lane and appears to collide with or narrowly miss the black van’s rear-left side; spray and sudden lateral movement of the black van are visible, indicating impact or evasive maneuver.

A black SUV is seen stopped on the right shoulder with its rear hatch open and a yellow object (likely a damaged part or debris) on the ground beside it; a silver sedan is parked further ahead on the shoulder, indicating a recent collision or breakdown event.

A white car is seen stationary on the right shoulder/embankment, having left the roadway; this appears to be the result of a recent crash, as it is positioned abnormally and no recovery action is visible.; The white car remains stationary on the grassy embankment beside the highway, confirming a crash has occurred. A large cement mixer truck passes in the left lane, and the scene remains stable with no movement from the crashed vehicle.

A white truck has collided with the left-side guardrail on a highway, resulting in significant front-end damage and debris scattered across the lane. The truck remains stationary against the barrier throughout the sequence, with visible deformation of the cab and detached parts. A driver is visible inside the cab in later frames (e.g., f6–f15).
